list.subtitle: All the properties you own or manage.
list.emptyText: Add your first property to get started.

form.name: Property name
form.nameHint: A name you will recognise, for example “Kibagabaga Residence”.
form.nameRequired: Please give the property a name.
form.addressHint: For example: KG 15 Ave, near the market.
form.descriptionHint: Anything useful to know about the property.
form.notesHint: Only you and your managers can see these notes.
form.created: “{{name}}” was added. Now add its rental units.

detail.deleteText: Only possible when nothing has been recorded for it yet.

units.emptyText: Add each apartment, house or room that you rent out.

unit.createdNextText: Next step: invite the tenant who lives here.
unit.deleteText: Only possible when nothing has been recorded for this unit yet.
unit.deleteConfirmText: This removes the unit for good. This cannot be undone.

unitForm.help: A unit is one apartment, house or room that you rent out.
unitForm.name: Unit name or number
unitForm.nameHint: For example: A1, Ground floor, Main house.
unitForm.nameRequired: Please enter a name or number for the unit.

tenants.subtitle: The people living in your properties.
tenants.pickUnit: Which unit will the tenant live in?
tenants.noVacant: All your units already have a tenant or an invitation.
tenants.search: Search by name, email or unit
tenants.emptyText: Open a unit and invite the tenant who lives there.
tenants.moveOutText: The tenant will no longer see this home. All the history stays in the property records.

invite.title: Invite a tenant to {{unit}}
invite.name: Tenant's full name
invite.emailHint: The tenant will sign in with this email.
invite.rentHint: Leave empty if you do not want to track rent.

invite.linkHint: Works once, for 14 days. Do not share it publicly.

invite.linkLostHint: Lost the link? Create a new one — the old link will stop working.
invite.cancelConfirmText: {{name}} will not be able to use the link any more.

managers.notFound: We could not find a property manager account with this email.
